name: Manticore
summary: The Scorched Earth guardian alternates between airborne and grounded attack opportunities. This arena permits eligible flyers; it is separate from Astraeos and old ASE encounters.
location: Summon the Scorched Earth arena through the current ASA Obelisk terminal; check entry conditions in your Single Player save.
rewardsNote: Difficulty affects Tek unlocks and ascension. Exact reward amounts are not verified in this profile; check current ASA rewards in game.
strategy: Keep the army controlled and watch landing windows; ranged backup reduces reliance on frequent landings.
Maintain rider protection and prepare for arena minions. Avoid letting the group become scattered while chasing flight phases.
Compare the terminal with this wiki-derived tribute table before summoning. Single Player and mod settings affect army performance.
kit: Fully healed eligible tames with checked saddles
Enough ammunition for phase control and ranged backup
Backup breeding pair safely left at base
